records.name: Kommandantin Nochneun
records.biography_en: Can make a room feel ready by counting loudly enough. Her HyperNorm lights announce readiness in three reliable colours. A dissonant card asks whether the quiet person at the back has finished checking. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bereitschaft wird durch hörbare Rückzählung unterstützt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can make a room feel ready by counting loudly enough.

records.name: Knopfwart Gleichgleich
records.biography_en: Would like a moment to confirm what everybody means by now. His HyperNorm button marks the boundary between waiting and the official irreversible moment. A dissonant card asks what now means to everybody else. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Zeitpunkt ist eindeutig, sobald er abgestimmt wurde.

variant_notes.note_en: Would like a moment to confirm what everybody means by now.

records.name: Logbuchfrau Nachgetragen
records.biography_en: Records the decisive moment after it has acquired an approved wording. Her HyperNorm logbook converts messy events into approved sequence. A dissonant card asks her to preserve the hesitation between two entries. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der entscheidende Augenblick wurde nachträglich sprachlich freigegeben.

variant_notes.note_en: Records the decisive moment after it has acquired an approved wording.

records.name: Schüsselhörer Ferngenau
records.biography_en: Can hear everything except the part everyone claims was obvious. His dish catches HyperNorm signals classified as either instruction or interference. A dissonant card sounds inconveniently like a neighbour needing an explanation. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Empfang ist vollständig. Das Selbstverständliche fehlt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can hear everything except the part everyone claims was obvious.

records.name: Treibstoffwart Brennruhig
records.biography_en: Keeps the volatile part better contained than the briefing. His sealed HyperNorm canister receives more careful handling than the expectations around it. A dissonant card suggests testing the briefing for leaks too. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Flüchtige wurde besser als die Erwartungen gesichert.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the volatile part better contained than the briefing.

records.name: Houston Rückfrage
records.biography_en: Has already called it a problem and is waiting for the approved synonym. His handset reports a HyperNorm problem before the naming committee approves one. A dissonant card stays on the line without demanding reassurance. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Störung wartet auf eine betriebsverträglichere Bezeichnung.

variant_notes.note_en: Has already called it a problem and is waiting for the approved synonym.
